messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or is observed on the nearest weekday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces) | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day (all provinces) | Monday | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |

### Quick‑look in JSON (for easy integration)

```json
[
  {"date":"2023-02-20","holiday":"Family Day","province":"AB, BC, SK, ON","weekday":"Monday"},
  {"date":"2023-04-07","holiday":"Good Friday","weekday":"Friday"},
  {"date":"2023-05-22","holiday":"Victoria Day","weekday":"Monday"},
  {"date":"2023-07-03","holiday":"Canada Day (observed)","weekday":"Monday"},
  {"date":"2023-09-04","holiday":"Labour Day","weekday":"Monday"},
  {"date":"2023-10-09","holiday":"Thanksgiving","weekday":"Monday"},
  {"date":"2023-12-25","holiday":"Christmas Day","weekday":"Monday"}
]
```

> **Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can store this data in a local database or fetch it from an API such as the *Canadian Holidays API* (https://canadianholidays.com/api/) for future years.

Let me know if you’d like the same information for other years or additional details (e.g., province‑specific holidays).
